why_not: Statistical yearbook: an output of the register rather than evidence of the capture mechanism, and over cap.

title: إطلاق مشروع نظام إدارة المعلومات التربوية OpenEMIS بالتعاون مع اليونيسف
why_not: The OpenEMIS launch with a 205-institution pilot would be the ideal baseline, but the agent returned a corrupted percent-encoded URL and it was not resolvable in this pass. Worth an acquisition line.

title: اطلاق منظومة بيانات التعليم
why_not: Launch notice for the predecessor system; superseded by the 2026 data-centre statement.

title: الاجتماع الثاني مع منظمة اليونيسيف بخصوص مشروع open EMIS
why_not: Design-stage meeting, superseded and out of window.

title: وزارة التربية والتعليم تستكمل إدراج مؤسسات التعليم الخاص ضمن منظومة بيانات التعليم
why_not: Already staged by a sibling slice in this batch; also private education, not rural primary schools.

title: وزارة التربية والتعليم تعقد اجتماعها الفني بحضور وكيلي الوزارة
why_not: A technical meeting agenda item on linking student registration; no completion claimed and nothing rural.

title: قانون رقم (8) لسنة 2014 بشأن الرقم الوطني
why_not: The legal framework, already staged by a sibling slice in this batch; and a statute establishing the national number is not evidence of office-level capture.

title: قانون رقم 36 لسنة 1968م بشأن الأحوال المدنية
why_not: The only instrument that speaks to remote areas explicitly, permitting a local-administration member to be delegated registry functions in remote areas - but it is a 1968 statute and says nothing about digitisation. Over cap.

title: مشروع الرقم الوطني
publisher: مشروع الرقم الوطني / مصلحة الأحوال المدنية
why_not: The national number project's public page, undated, describing enquiry services rather than office capture.

title: ربط المنظومة الخاصة بالرقم الوطني مع مختلف الجهات الحكومية بمدينة سرت.
why_not: The single most rural-specific item located anywhere in this slice, naming weak electronic performance at Zamzam, Abu Njeim, Abu Hadi and Harawa - but it is from 2014 and cannot be projected onto 2026.

title: امين مكتب مصلحة الاحوال المدنية بسرت يتابع العمل بمكاتب السجل المدني الثلاثين والغربيات والاربعين واهراة.
why_not: Peripheral offices completing 10,000-plus transactions in a month, but out of window and silent on whether capture is electronic.

title: تواصل مشروع الانطلاقة لمطابقة البيانات الالكترونية بمنظومة الأحوال المدنية.
why_not: Same programme as the selected baseline without the office count; the Alwasat report carries the 257 figure.

title: النائب العام يناقش مع مصلحة الأحول المدنية مشروع استحداث قاعدة بيانات السجل المدني الإلكترونية ونتائج تحقيق واقعات التزوير.
why_not: A genuine second in-window event, but national in scope with nothing on rural or peripheral offices, and already staged by a sibling slice in this batch. Held back rather than pad a rural indicator with a second national item.

title: الهيئة العامة للمعلومات تستعرض رؤيتها الوطنية لتطوير البنية التحتية الرقمية للخدمات العامة (DPI)
why_not: LY-DNID biometric trial phase three; enabling infrastructure for identity, not civil registry office operation, and belongs to dpi.id.

title: مركز المعلومات والتوثيق بوزارة الداخلية يباشر بتركيب نظام إصدار الحالة الجنائية والخدمات المصاحبة له للمنطقة الشرقية.
why_not: Criminal-status certificate issuance across nine named cities: a certificate service, not station-level incident capture, and out of window.

title: مركز المعلومات والتوثيق يستكمل التجهيزات لإصدار شهادة الحالة الجنائية الإلكترونية بـمديرية أمن الجفارة .
why_not: Jafara equipping plus a daily-reports system for the operations room; peripheral to Tripoli but out of window and not station capture.

title: تفعيل نظام غرف العمليات الذكية والاستعلام الأمني الموحد بجهاز الأمن العام والتمركزات الأمنية.
why_not: Operations-room and unified query layer, not station records, and out of window.

title: استراتيجية التحول الرقمي الحكومي في دولة ليبيا
why_not: National strategy naming interior ministry services and the need for digital access in remote areas; a policy target, not police-station evidence, and over cap.

title: Inauguration of Model Police Station in Tripoli
why_not: Out of window by four years and a physical model station rather than a records system.

title: مركز البحوث الجنائية والتدريب ينفذ دورة تدريبية حول إدارة الوثائق والملفات وحفظها وأرشفتها.
why_not: A real in-window movement - 16 Tripoli police personnel trained in digitising and indexing files toward integrating the police and prosecution databases - but 16 people in one directorate is too thin to record as progress on a rural indicator. Held back rather than pad.

title: أبوزريبة: التحول الرقمي وتطوير المنظومات الإدارية ركيزة أساسية لتحديث العمل الأمني
why_not: The most geographically relevant in-window item, an interior ministry directive to complete the electronic system across all security directorates with Derna named - but it reached us only through two novel aggregator domains and states an instruction, not a deployment.

title: البرنامج الوطني للمشروعات الصغرى والمتوسطة
why_not: Fetched. Carries the enumeration - three incubators and eight business centres - and would be the alternative baseline, but the business centres are general-purpose and the count is not a technology-hub figure. Its enumeration is recorded in the selected baseline's note.

title: الرئسية - LDIL
why_not: Fetched. The Libyan Digital Innovation Lab, an official innovation-ecosystem mapping observatory launched 2024-04-04 - relevant and undated on its own page. Over cap under the one-baseline rule; a strong acquisition line.

title: حاضنة أعمال جامعة بنغازي
why_not: Second of the three incubators; over cap.

title: مركز الريادة والإبتكار - جامعة سبها
why_not: Established under decision 543 of 2018; over cap.

title: مركز الريادة والابتكار - جامعة طبرق
why_not: Names ministerial decision 722 of 2021 establishing entrepreneurship and innovation centres across Libyan universities - the enacting act for the university hub network, and the best alternative baseline. Over cap; the decree itself is worth an acquisition line.

title: مركز الريادة والابتكار | عن المركز
why_not: Names decisions 1100 and 1633 of 2022; over cap.

title: tec+
why_not: The clearest Libyan hub-to-accelerator institution, undated on its own page; over cap.

title: Strengthening Design and Setup of Business Start-Up Accelerator
why_not: Dated and documented, 10 months and 30 startups across Tripoli, Benghazi and Sabha; over cap and one accelerator rather than the hub landscape.

title: MoLG, EU and UNDP establish the first-ever Municipality led Business Incubator in the heart of Tripoli
why_not: Names ministry decision 1500 of 2021 permitting municipalities to establish incubators; out of window and status since 2023 unconfirmed.

title: SPARK calls for entrepreneurs to join incubators in Benghazi and Al-Bayda
why_not: Silphium Labs at Omar Al-Mukhtar University and Asarya in Benghazi; the second incubation cycle it documents is May 2025, before the window opens.

title: Witness the power of youth innovation!
why_not: EcoLink innovation camp at the University of Tripoli with 100-plus students - a genuine in-window event, but the only route offered is a LinkedIn post, which is not a publisher document.

title: حكومة الدبيبة توقع اتفاقية لإقامة مخيم سامسونغ للابتكار في ليبيا
why_not: Fetched. Same event as the LANA Samsung report selected under capacity.literacy; a training camp rather than a hub.

title: قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 948 لسنة 2022 م بشأن إنشاء قطب صناعي تكنولوجي
why_not: Establishes an industrial-technology pole with an incubation function; over cap and less directly about startups than Decision 23 of 2025.

title: قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 519 لسنة 2013 م بشأن إنشاء صندوق ريادة للمشروعات الصغرى والمتوسطة
why_not: LYD 200m entrepreneurship fund, still in force; the antecedent instrument, over cap.

title: قرار رقم 81 لسنة 2025 م بشأن اعتماد لائحة تنظيم دعم الشركات الناشئة
why_not: The implementing regulation for the selected baseline decree, and Decision 121 of 2025 amends it; both over cap and both worth acquisition lines.

title: Libya Start-up!
why_not: EUR 5.5m EU startup-ecosystem programme; out of window and over cap.

title: New entrepreneurship initiative to boost job creation in Libya
why_not: Dirayah, 60 youth-led innovative projects across four cities; out of window and over cap.

title: STREAM - Support programme for the Libyan innovation ecosystem
why_not: Closed on 30 September 2020; explicitly not evidence of current capacity.

title: The Private Sector amid Conflict: The Case of Libya
why_not: Evidence that Libya lacked an entrepreneurship strategy at the time; a diagnostic, not the instrument, and superseded by the 2025 decree.

title: نتائج الهاكاثون الوطني للابتكار والتكنولوجيا
why_not: HINTX 2025 national hackathon with named winners, sponsored by Huawei and Libyana - a real second in-window event, held back as the weaker of the two competitions and because a hackathon result is thinner than a 600-entry incubator competition.

title: الدبيبة يعتمد ميثاق الأخلاقيات والاستراتيجية الوطنية للذكاء الصناعي 2026-2030
why_not: Carries a target of 100 AI startups, but it is the national AI strategy and belongs to gov.policy and tech.ai, not to this indicator; a sibling slice's territory.

title: INFRASTRUCTURE and ACCESS - Digital Development Dashboard, Libya
why_not: Fetched and staged, then WITHDRAWN before finishing: a sibling slice staged the later edition of the same ITU series with the same NA finding, and operative beats superseded. The selection now points at the sibling's file.

title: SDG 4 - Country Profiles: Libya
why_not: States plainly that Libya has no data for SDG indicator 4.4.1 on ICT skills - the same finding as the selected baseline, from a second authority, but undated and over cap.

title: The Libyan National Report on Adult learning and Literacy Education
publisher: General People's Committee for Education / UNESCO UIL
why_not: Carries real Libyan figures - 8,300 in general computer courses 2007-08, 3,400 ICDL completions 2008-09 - but they cover teachers and education staff, not the general population, and the report describes a superseded state.

title: استبيانات - الهيئة العامة للمعلومات
why_not: GIA and ESCWA questionnaires on digital accessibility and digital development, but scoped to government institutions and with no published results.

title: Raqameyon : empowering tomorrows digital innovators in Libya
why_not: 2,160 trained on Microsoft tools, 240 entrepreneurs; programme reach, not a population measure. Already raised as an acquisition line by the 2026-08-10 gap probe.

title: RAQAM-E
why_not: National coding training centre, four coding schools, a womens training centre, 22 trainers; same reason, and already an acquisition line.

title: Action Document for EU4SKILLS in Libya
why_not: Strong on the measurement gap - no official labour force survey since 2011 - but publishes no digital-literacy baseline and is over cap.

title: الدبيبة يعتمد ميثاق أخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي ويطلق الاستراتيجية الوطنية للتحول الرقمي 2026-2030.
why_not: Carries digital-capacity targets including 10,000 staff trained and digital identity for 70 per cent of the population, but they are targets not measures, and the strategy belongs to gov.policy - a sibling slice's territory.

title: Workshop of the Digital Lab to Monitor Progress on the Skills Assessment Platform and Digital Index
why_not: The 7-8 February 2026 workshop is a step within the Qudurat build, not a distinct event from the April report selected.

title: تقسيم المقرّرات الدراسية لجميع صفوف مرحلتي التعليم الأساسي والثانوي
why_not: Fetched. The reason this indicator has no curricular baseline: the ministry's own 2024-2025 curriculum distribution page links six per-grade PDFs and names no subject at all, so it neither establishes nor excludes a computing course.

title: The Development of education in the Great Jamahiriya
publisher: Libyan National Commission for Education, Science and Culture
why_not: Lists Computer in the secondary study plan, the oldest direct evidence - but it describes the pre-2011 system and is superseded.

title: قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم 1013 لسنة 2022 م بشأن إصدار لائحة تنظيم شؤون التربية والتعليم لمرحلتي التعليم الأساسي والثانوي
why_not: The governing regulation for basic and secondary education, but it names no ICT subject; staging it would be padding the cap with a general education instrument.

title: دراسة نقدية لمنهج تقنية المعلومات في السنة الأولى من التعليم الثانوي
publisher: مجلة جامعة بني وليد للعلوم الإنسانية والتطبيقية
why_not: Corroborates that a first-year secondary information technology textbook exists - useful, but a critical study is commentary, not the instrument.

title: Survey of ICT and Education in Africa: Libya Country Report
why_not: About 50 per cent computer penetration in secondary schools in 2007; measures equipment rather than teaching, and is nineteen years old.

title: الدراســــة الذاتيــــة
publisher: مكتب ضمان الجودة، كلية تقنية المعلومات، جامعة طرابلس
why_not: Fetched. The best-argued candidate - 214 graduates in 2023/24 and an explicit statement that employment is not yet tracked - but the PDF Arabic extraction is letter-order corrupted in its justified paragraphs, so a verbatim capture would be unreliable. Its employment-tracking finding is carried in the selected baseline note. Worth a re-acquisition with a proper Arabic PDF extractor.

title: حقائق حول كلية الهندسة
why_not: Fetched. 17,268 total graduates including 1,475 from computer engineering; a clean second institutional figure, over cap under the one-baseline rule.

title: خريجو كلية تقنية المعلومات
why_not: Fetched. An index page linking three graduate-list PDFs (autumn 2018 to spring 2023, autumn 2023, spring 2024); the underlying lists would give an annual series and are worth acquisition lines.

title: تقرير عام باعداد الطلاب الدارسين بالكلية
why_not: 31 computer graduates in 2023/24 with a nationality and sex split; a second faculty, over cap.

title: Analysis of Market Requirements in the Field of Information Technology in Libya
publisher: Surman Journal for Science and Technology
why_not: 78.8 per cent of surveyed HR and IT managers say new IT graduates lack labour-market skills - a skills-gap indicator on 33 responses, not a graduate-to-workforce rate.

title: VOCATIONAL EDUCATION AND TRAINING IN LIBYA
why_not: Youth unemployment 48.7 per cent and 30 per cent of firms struggling to hire qualified Libyans; national context, not ICT graduates.

title: Labor Market Dynamics in Libya: Reintegration for Recovery
why_not: General labour-market baseline from 2015; does not identify computing graduates.

title: SDG 4 - Country Profiles: Libya
why_not: Checked and negative: UIS publishes no ICT (ISCED 06) or engineering (ISCED 07) graduate count for Libya. This is why the baseline is institutional.

title: تفعيل كليتي تقنية المعلومات والقانون بجامعة الكفرة بتكليف عمداء لهما
why_not: Activating an IT faculty at Al-Kufra University would extend graduate capacity into the south - a real in-window event, but the only route is a novel broadcaster relaying a ministerial decision, with no ministry page located.

title: منصة تواصل
why_not: Fetched. The GACI telecoms complaints portal is live but the page carries almost no text beyond four counters reading 13 complaints, 13 new, 0 in progress, 0 resolved; below the cap behind the ACA raqeb portal, which is national and cross-sector.

title: الهيئة العامة للاتصالات والمعلوماتية - ليبيا
why_not: Fetched. GACI's own site names three citizen platforms - تواصل for telecoms complaints, رابط for reporting fake links and آراء for public consultations - and carries its 2024 penetration indicators, but it is a shifting homepage and is undated; kept as a lead rather than staged. Route: curl returns an 854-byte JavaScript shell, Exa returns the rendered page.

title: عن الهيئة - هيئة الرقابة الإدارية
why_not: Fetched. A legislative history of the Administrative Control Authority from 1950 to Law No. 20 of 2013; it grounds the raqeb portal's legal basis, which is recorded in the baseline's note instead of being staged separately.

title: منصة آراء - الهيئة العامة للإتصالات والمعلوماتية
why_not: Fetched. GACI describes آراء as the main portal for collecting and classifying information to build a database for Libya's digital transformation, but the two live forms on it are a household gas-cylinder request and a telecoms fault report - a data-collection and service-request channel, not a policy consultation platform, so it answers neither indicator well.

title: Technical Guidebook: Inclusive Budgeting Responsive to the Needs of All Groups in Libya
why_not: Fetched. A 71-page gender-responsive budgeting guidebook for the planning, finance and sector ministries; a real in-window publication but a tool rather than a movement in women's access to services, and the fetched publication page is mostly site navigation. Third behind MICS7 and the GIA women's consultation.

title: Structured Dialogue concludes, presents final recommendations for Libya's political process
publisher: United Nations Support Mission in Libya (UNSMIL)
why_not: Fetched and staged, but under include.access--citizen-participation-in-policy. Returned again here because persons with disabilities were among the Dialogue's members; below the cap for this indicator behind the digital accessibility policy and the disability charter, both of which bear directly on services.

title: National Union Bank Launches Expat Accounts to Boost Digital Payments in Libya
why_not: Not fetched, recorded as a lead. Benghazi-based National Union Bank opened accounts for regular foreign workers with a local debit card, electronic services and internal transfers; a third in-window event of the same kind, below the cap behind the CBL rule and the first dedicated e-wallet.

title: الباعور: ليبيا تمتلك جاهزية رقمية مرتفعة ونسبة انتشار الإنترنت تتجاوز 90%
why_not: Fetched. GACI chairman Abdul Basit Al-Baour told National Information Technology Day in Tripoli on 1 June 2026 that internet penetration exceeds 90 per cent and smart-device ownership 85 per cent, and called for at least USD 5bn of investment in the sector. Left unselected because the claim carries no methodology and no regional, urban-rural or gender split, so it cannot evidence a narrowing divide; it is the freshest national figure available if the cap is widened.

title: آخر الإصدارات - مصلحة الإحصاء والتعداد
why_not: Fetched. The Bureau's latest-releases listing, cited as the route to an expanded or final MICS7 national report dated 6 August 2026. It is a listing page rather than the report, and no direct file URL for that report was established, so nothing was staged from it; the October 2025 findings report is staged as the baseline instead.

title: الإحصاءات الحيوية والإدارية
why_not: Fetched. The Bureau's Vital and Administrative Statistics department page, listing سلسلة الاحصاءات الحيوية 2012-2022 م and annual volumes for 2007, 2008 and 2011. It is an index of four rows with no substantive body, so it was not staged; its content is recorded in the baseline's note.

title: نبذة عن المركز - المركز الوطني للأرصاد الجوية
why_not: Fetched over a pinned route. The Centre's institutional history: Libya joined WMO on 29 December 1955 as member 67, Law No. 13 of 1991 defines the meteorology sector, the WMO/UNDP development project document was signed on 10 February 2000, and the observing network totals about 50 stations. It does NOT state satellite-imagery use in its body, contrary to a secondary account, so the WMO News-from-Members record was preferred as the baseline. Route: the host does not resolve through this machine's system resolver; it resolves over DoH to 168.119.209.42 and returns 200 to a curl pinned with --resolve.
